title: Comptages multimodaux à Paris
description: Volumes observés et horaires moyens ; ils ne mesurent pas la saturation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT valeur_numerique AS "Véhicules comptés" FROM gold_kpi WHERE kpi_id = 'total_usagers'
SELECT valeur_numerique AS "Sites actifs" FROM gold_kpi WHERE kpi_id = 'sites_actifs'
SELECT valeur_numerique AS "Heure locale" FROM gold_kpi WHERE kpi_id = 'heure_pointe_moyenne'
SELECT make_date(annee, mois, 1)::timestamp AS "time", mode_deplacement AS metric, total_usagers AS value FROM gold_serie_mensuelle ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sites aux volumes mesurés les plus élevés

targets.rawSql: SELECT identifiant_site, COALESCE(nom_du_site, identifiant_site) AS site, SUM(total_usagers) AS vehicules FROM gold_sites_classement GROUP BY identifiant_site, nom_du_site ORDER BY vehicules DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Profil jour et heure par mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT mode_deplacement, jour_semaine, heure, moyenne_par_heure, nb_sites_heures_mesurees FROM gold_heatmap_heure_jour ORDER BY moyenne_par_heure DESC LIMIT 30
